The equivalences of Lemmas <REF_0001> and
<REF_0002>
are compatible with pullbacks. For example, suppose <MATH_0001>
is a morphism of connected schemes. Let <MATH_0002> be geometric
point of <MATH_0003> and set <MATH_0004>.
Then the diagram
<MATHSEG_0001>finite locally constant sheaves of sets on <MATHSEG_0002>finite <MATHSEG_0003>-sets<MATHSEG_0004>finite locally constant sheaves of sets on <MATHSEG_0005>finite <MATHSEG_0006>-sets<MATHSEG_0007>
is commutative, where the vertical arrow on the right comes
from the continuous homomorphism
<MATH_0005>
induced by <MATH_0006>. This follows immediately from
the commutative diagram in
Fundamental Groups, Theorem <REF_0003>.
A similar result holds for the other cases.
